snippet.title: Future of E-commerce & Strategic Partnerships | Venu Nair | Beyond The Fabric Myntra Podcast Ep. 2
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Beyond the Fabric, the official Myntra podcast where we speak with leaders across our business. In Episode 2, we decode the future of e-commerce, strategic partnerships, and the ultimate differentiator in India: Speed.

Venu Nair (Chief of Strategic Partnerships and Omnichannel at Myntra) sits down with Hema Pachisia (Senior Director, Human Capital) to discuss how global brands succeed in the Indian market and how to create a truly seamless shopping experience. Discover the evolving expectations of digital consumers, how Myntra uses data to drive personalization, and why unified retail, powered by 90-minute deliveries via M-NOW, is the future of fashion.

11:54 – One learning habit Venu heavily relies on
